Occurrences.Kwic: 夫學有內有外，內學者何？滿龍宮，盈海藏，西天此土，梵語唐言，千七百則，陳爛葛藤，出世閒一切著述是也。外學者何？墳典丘索，詩書六藝，厔盩津逮之藏，國門名山之業，春秋史學，諸子百家，世閒一切典籍是也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X63/X63n1259.xml). Discourse on Training in the Chan Gate. Huishan Jiexian owns the retained deployment: his manual's chapter on polishing study counts the seventeen hundred cases among the worn-out vines that make up inner learning.

Occurrences.Kwic: 百千異流，咸歸大海；百千異法，咸歸此宗。如天普葢，似地普擎。燕語鶯吟，共演如來實相；山青水綠，單明清淨法身。若是英特上士，便好喝散大眾，掀倒禪床，將山僧爛搥一頓，道：且莫誤賺後人，瞎將來眼。豈不慶快平生？若也只麼握節當胸，伏聽處分，不免引些陳爛葛藤，牽惹諸人去也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1397.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xueyan Zuqin. Xueyan Zuqin owns the retained deployment: his hall sermon says that whoever merely waits for instruction obliges him to drag out some worn-out vines to stir the assembly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 優婆到海會臨時請上堂逼拶額汗出無法可商量只得聊借拂子說些陳爛葛藤豎起拂子云者個上與十方諸佛同一道故下與一切眾生共一悲仰

Mingjue Cong owns the retained deployment: pressed to an unscheduled hall talk for a visiting lay patron, he says there is nothing to discuss and he can only borrow the whisk and speak some worn-out vines.

Senses.Explanation: A dismissive name for repeatedly handled inherited cases, sayings, and verbal entanglements, even when deliberately raised again as expedient material. Zhongfeng Mingben uses the expression through direct appraisal of the seventeen hundred cases. Xuejiao Yuanxin independently deploys it through independent contrast with fresh vines.
